create.subtitle: Describe the world you want to create. WorldX will design the landscape, craft the mechanics, create characters that think for themselves, and bring everything to life.
create.promptPlaceholder: A cozy mountain village in autumn, with a blacksmith, a tea house owner, a wandering monk and a curious child...
create.emptyError: Please describe the world you want to create.
create.conflictError: A world is already being generated. You can attach to the running job to follow its progress.
create.switchFailed: World was generated but switching failed: {{error}}
create.phase1Hint: LLM is dreaming up regions, characters and lore.
create.phase2Hint: Image model paints the world; vision model annotates it.
create.phase3Hint: Sprite sheets are generated and cleaned up.
create.phase4Hint: Configs, navigation points and runtime are assembled.
create.tipRunning: You can leave this tab open or close it — generation runs on the server and resumes when you come back.
create.tipSwitching: Switching you into the new world…
create.sampleWorldsOr: or skip creating — try a ready-made world
create.sampleWorldsHint: These sample worlds are pre-built and ready to explore right away.

charDetail.planHint: Steps are planned by AI from the core quest; the character revises them while acting.
charDetail.planEmpty: No action plan yet. Give this character a core quest and they will first plan their own steps, then follow them.
charDetail.nameTaken: That name is already used by another character — pick a different one.
charDetail.fieldMemories: Memories (one per line; shown under "what you remember")
charDetail.fieldEditPassword: Edit password (from the admin; required to save)
charDetail.editPasswordWrong: Incorrect edit password — ask the admin for it
charDetail.gateHint: 🔒 This character requires an edit password. Enter the one the admin gave you to view and change the profile.
charDetail.fieldCoreQuest: Quest (typing anything starts it, clearing stops it — drives the character's actions, movement and talk)
charDetail.phAppearanceHint: e.g. shirt and jacket with a work badge, looks sharp but a bit tired
charDetail.phCoreValues: e.g. results first, get things done
charDetail.phSkills: e.g. data analysis, cross-team communication, writing proposals
charDetail.phPreferredActivities: e.g. gym, trying new restaurants, binge-watching
charDetail.phFears: e.g. being laid off, presenting to a crowd
charDetail.phBackstory: e.g. left a big tech firm three years ago, still wants to ship a project of their own
charDetail.phSpeechQuirks: e.g. corporate jargon like "let's align on this", sighs before speaking
charDetail.phCatchphrases: e.g. Let's sync on that later
charDetail.phCoreQuest: e.g. get the new proposal approved and funded before the quarterly review

god.title: God Mode
god.subtitle: Inject events or memories into the world. Characters will perceive these changes via LLM.
god.worldPromptPlaceholder: e.g. A night market in Bianjing, Northern Song dynasty. Locals and travelling merchants mingle; strangers start conversations over trade or directions…
god.worldPromptHint: This text is injected as the "world background" into every character's decision and dialogue prompts. It takes effect immediately on save (the next AI call uses it). Left empty, the world description is used instead.
god.worldPromptSavedNoPersist: Applied, but writing to the config file failed — a restart will revert it
god.charQuest: Core quest (optional — typing anything activates it; the character moves, acts and talks around it)
god.charQuestPlaceholder: e.g. get the new proposal approved and funded before the quarterly review
god.charSpriteHint: Picking an existing character copies their sprite sheet — handy when you have no image model. After creating, use "Edit profile" to fill in skills/hobbies/values etc.
god.charNameTaken: That name is already used by another character
god.charCreated: Created "{{name}}" and added them to the world
god.deleteCharHint: Deleting removes the character from the world and map, and clears their state, memories, diary and sprite in the current timeline (past events are kept, so timeline replay still works). This cannot be undone.
god.deleteCharConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Their state, memories, diary, sprite and config file will be removed permanently.
god.envNoObjects: No interactive objects in this location
god.envHint: State / state description take effect immediately — e.g. set a stall's description to "smashed to pieces" and characters will perceive it on their next decision. Names and descriptions are written back to the config file (kept across restarts).
god.passwordHint: Every character has a 12-character edit password. Give it to the matching player — they must enter it in "Edit profile" to change that character. Regenerating invalidates the old password immediately.
god.passwordCopyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
god.passwordRegenerated: Regenerated — tell the player the new password
god.broadcastPlaceholder: e.g. A sudden downpour drenches the entire area…
god.broadcastSuccess: Broadcasted to {{count}} characters, takes effect next tick
god.whisperPlaceholder: e.g. You vaguely recall seeing a familiar figure at the dock three days ago…
god.whisperHint: Start with "you" — the character will perceive it as their own memory.
god.presetRainContent: A sudden downpour drenches the area — rain hammers the rooftops.
god.presetBlackoutContent: The entire area plunges into darkness — a blackout. Only scattered candles and phone screens glow.
god.presetStrangerContent: An unknown stranger appears at the door, seemingly asking around about something.
god.presetLetterContent: Someone finds an unsigned letter on the table, its contents unsettling.
god.presetWindContent: A fierce wind sweeps through, scattering objects everywhere.
god.presetBirdsContent: A flock of dark birds circles overhead, lingering as if watching something.

sandbox.title: Sandbox Chat
sandbox.subtitle: No memory, no world impact — pull a character out for a private conversation.
sandbox.identityPlaceholder: Leave empty = they don't know who you are; or write: a visitor claiming to be from the future…
sandbox.hint: This conversation is fully isolated from the main simulation: no memories generated, no character behavior affected. Session is destroyed on close.
sandbox.emptyChat: (Type a message and hit Send to begin)
sandbox.sessionExpired: This chat session has expired. Please start a new one.
sandbox.presetOldFriendVal: An old friend they haven't seen in a long time.
sandbox.presetReporterVal: A reporter working on a story, asking questions.
sandbox.presetStrangerVal: A stranger met by chance on the street.
sandbox.presetFutureSelfVal: Someone claiming to be their future self — not sure if real.
sandbox.presetEnemyVal: Someone from an opposing faction, approaching with unclear motives.
